summary: Two women came to Solomon, both claiming the same baby. Solomon wisely tested them, and the real mother showed her love by wanting the baby to live. All Israel saw that God had given Solomon wisdom.

story_reel.narration: One day, two women came to King Solomon with a big problem. The first woman said, 'My lord, this woman and I live in the same house. We each had a baby boy. But in the night, her baby died. So she got up and switched the babies! She took my son and put her baby beside me. In the morning, I knew it wasn't my son!' The second woman said, 'No! The living baby is mine!' They argued back and forth right in front of the king. There were no witnesses, no tests, nobody else who knew the truth. How could anyone decide? Solomon said, 'Bring me a sword.' The servants brought one. Then Solomon said, 'Divide the living child in two, and give half to each woman.' Of course, Solomon would never really hurt the baby. He was testing their hearts. Right away, the real mother cried out, 'Oh, my lord, give her the baby! Don't hurt him!' She loved her son so much she would rather give him away than see him hurt. But the other woman said, 'Go ahead, divide him.' Then Solomon said, 'Give the baby to the first woman. She is his mother.' When all Israel heard about this, they were amazed. They could see that God had given Solomon wisdom to do what was right.

memory_verse.text: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh gives me wisdom to see what's true and do what's right.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Solomon used wisdom to find out the truth. When is a time you needed wisdom to know what was right?
reflection_choices: When I didn't know who was telling the truth
When I had to make a choice

quiz.question: What problem did the two women bring to Solomon?
options: They both said the same baby was theirs
quiz.explanation: The one said, 'The living one is my son,' and the other said, 'No, the dead one is your son.'

quiz.question: How did the real mother show her love?
options: She asked Solomon to give the baby to the other woman so he would live
quiz.explanation: She said, 'Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!'

quiz.question: What did all Israel see about Solomon?
options: The wisdom of God was in him
quiz.explanation: They saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, You give wisdom! Help me see what's true and do what's right, even when things are confusing. Fill me with Your understanding. Amen.

companion.message: That was my first big test as king! I didn't know who was telling the truth, but God showed me how to see their hearts. Real love always protects.

review.notes: A baby's death (3:19) is mentioned; Solomon's order to divide the child (3:24-25) is included, with the narration stating plainly that he would never really hurt the baby. No harm shown. Confirm.
